findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_land_valuation, get_land_activity · Private data: get_land_property, get_fabrica_lending_market, get_fabrica_loan_book, get_land_portfolio, get_fabrica_stats, get_land_trust_documents, get_land_activity, get_land_order_book, get_land_portfolio_map_image, ask_fabrica, find_us_parcel, contact_fabrica_support, make_land_offer, list_land_for_sale, accept_land_offer, buy_land, cancel_land_order, borrow_against_land, repay_loan_against_land · Public sink: contact_fabrica_support.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_land_valuation, get_land_activity · Private data: get_land_property, get_fabrica_lending_market, get_fabrica_loan_book, get_land_portfolio, get_fabrica_stats, get_land_trust_documents, get_land_activity, get_land_order_book, get_land_portfolio_map_image, ask_fabrica, find_us_parcel, contact_fabrica_support, make_land_offer, list_land_for_sale, accept_land_offer, buy_land, cancel_land_order, borrow_against_land, repay_loan_against_land · Public sink: contact_fabrica_support

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
